hypothesis: Increasing the concentration of Oct4 transcription factor beyond a threshold will induce reprogramming of differentiated cells to a pluripotent state
prediction: The minimum concentration of Oct4 required to reprogram differentiated cells is 10% higher than the concentration found in embryonic stem cells
measurement_method: Measure Oct4 concentration in embryonic stem cells using fluorescence intensity, then test increasing concentrations of exogenous Oct4 in differentiated cells and quantify reprogramming efficiency through marker expression
falsification_condition: If reprogramming occurs at concentrations equal to or below the endogenous Oct4 level in embryonic stem cells, or if no reprogramming occurs at concentrations 25% above the endogenous level
